scope: Complete frozen TRAIN2558; 7 linear mixed-integer fits; reviewed prior balanced 3D controls reused exactly; 6 judge-only internal video exclusions. No new data roles, geometry or detector inference.
objective: min actual FA = number_wrong - sum(reject for wrong); reject iff s>=0. Each fitting video correct reject count <=floor(.05*correct_count). Both sign inequalities with fixed symmetric margin classify every training row consistently.
parameter_domain: 4 standardized linear coefficients including intercept in [-10,10]; every fitting signed logit magnitude>=.0001. Big M_i=10*sum(abs(design_i))+.0001. Feasible all-accept exists. Restricted numerical class, not unrestricted linear capacity.
solver: SciPy milp/HiGHS; presolve true, time limit60 seconds per context, node limit100000, relative gap0. No retries/search/budget extension. Save incumbent, integer lower/upper FA, gap, status/runtime. No incumbent uses explicitly marked feasible all-accept reference, not a trained candidate. Independent review verifies signs/counts but does not reconstruct a branch-and-bound proof.
control: Exact prior 3D weights/normalization/cutoffs from reviewed fr_constraint report; same fitting rows/fold membership; full control matches formal simple. Control cutoff max fitting-video correct95 quantile; historical full_simple trained all TRAIN is not a fair leave-video-out judge.
gate: Full TRAIN strict FA improvement at same CR against control; every held-video correct retention>=95%; pooled per-video offline correct95 FA strictly below control54; no per-video same-correct95/count/CR FA or same-CR continuous FR regression vs stated controls; any no-incumbent reference fails. Feasible but unresolved solver can be scored, never claims global optimum. Gate failure stops before VAL.
limitations: NP error-control idea adaptation, not reproduction or future-video statistical guarantee.
